rule.text: A kind is marked proven only with 50 graded games at one venue we read ourselves, a CLV t of 2 or more against Pinnacle's close, and results not running 1.5 sd under what that close expected. Never pooled, never alt or stale lines, never copied books, and of the pick'em kinds only sharp-price legs.

labels.tool: Exchange Shopper: best prices above fair
labels.why: A price above Pinnacle's fair, with what the exchange book fills. Exchange flags have not beaten the close yet.

labels.tool: NBA, CFB and CBB props models
labels.why: Our own projections. None has cleared our bar against the apps' lines in held-out tests.
Kalshi's price an hour before kickoff beat it in the held-out test.

labels.tool: Esports matchups (LoL, CS2, Valorant, Dota 2) and soccer
labels.why: The exchanges' own prices beat our ratings in walk-forward tests.
Unders where Pinnacle's map number sits under the apps' lines summed, priced on our kill model. Under 50 graded; nothing alerts.
A resting bid under the fair. Nothing places an order.

labels.tool: F1, golf and season futures outrights
labels.why: Pinnacle takes small limits there, so its fair is weaker.
Legs left up after news. Not ahead of the close so far.
Following big accounts has not beaten the close in our tests.

labels.tool: Pick'em leg flags (PrizePicks, Underdog, Sleeper, DK Pick6)
labels.why: Flagged legs have broken about even against Pinnacle's close.
